content.short: Stackup helps startups manage their crypto assets.
content.description: Stackup provides a smart account platform that streamlines on-chain operations and automates complex blockchain tasks across Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Avalanche, BNB Chain, and Multichain. It centralizes control over decentralized assets to enable secure, real-time crypto transactions for businesses. With robust security and adaptive features, Stackup empowers organizations to manage crypto operations with precision and speed, reducing friction and improving efficiency across multi-chain environments.
